notes.text: Cases, test data and notes now live in the shared store, so cases can be added or edited without a new version of the page. Saving a new result keeps the earlier one under Previous runs. Each case has a Post-upgrade check, and the Activity tab logs every change.
notes.title: Tracker v2 (11/19)

notes.text: The Admin Console Refund window replaces console refund work orders: refundable rows, several months at once, partial amounts, generic lines, optional approval, linking a DWP refund work order, delete-to-restore, Oracle export. H-03 and H-04 updated for DEF-068 / DEF-069.
notes.title: Refunds (H-06 to H-25)

notes.text: Ledger and module searches, Legacy ID search, missing-PTAEO tiles, View Details into v2, Master-only user. K-04 updated: Refund Request now opens the Refund window.
notes.title: Console (K-06 to K-12)

notes.text: New areas for the staging form and the redesigned record forms.
notes.title: Import staging (L) and Admin View v2 forms (M)

notes.text: Default SKU CGBDEFAULT, Chargeback tabs, Service SKU on Smart IT screens, wallet login, VM backup child subscription, award-manager changes, customer row stamping, Chargeback permission groups. E-15 updated for the 260 base VM rate. Not added: account co-managers (parked for a later release).
notes.title: Tickets, PTAEO, subscriptions, security

severity.def: Wrong amount, wrong account or duplicate posting reaches the ledger or the Finance export; data of another tenant affected; no workaround.
A required function does not work or blocks a test area; workaround is manual and risky.
Function works with an acceptable workaround, or a message / field value is wrong without financial impact.

areas.desc: Catalog item fields drive the ticket: SKU defaults, billing type, Do Not Bill, Retired, Private InfoSec.
areas.name: Catalog items and ticket setup

areas.desc: The billing account is filled automatically, validated, corrected and maintained.
areas.name: PTAEO defaulting and validation

areas.desc: Each billing model calculates the right charge on Incidents and Work Orders.
areas.name: Charge calculation

areas.desc: Every chargeable event writes one correct debit/credit pair, exactly once.
areas.name: Chargeback Ledger posting

areas.desc: Recurring charges are created, changed, suspended and ended correctly, including storage, VM, hosting and wireless data.
areas.name: Subscriptions and imports

areas.desc: The pre-15th manual steps and the 15th automated run work in sequence and stop on failure.
areas.name: Monthly billing cycle (Steps 1-7)
areas.note: Running the 15th steps on demand in DEV: open NN:CGB:BillingRun for the period (create it with Billing Period = current YYYY-MM if the 6:55 PM escalation has not created it) and set z1D Action = STEP5, then STEP6, then STEP7, saving after each.

areas.desc: Pending ledger lines become a balanced export batch with a checksum, exported exactly once.
areas.name: Oracle Finance export

areas.desc: Refunds through DWP work orders and the Admin Console Refund window: one reversed pair per refunded month, never more than was charged, with optional approval.
areas.name: Refunds
areas.note: Refund window tests (H-06 on): sign in as UAT Billing Admin (Chargeback Config). After importing the refund build, wait for the hourly backfill (:10 console, :40 DWP) before refunding. Refund pairs are written Pending in the current billing period; undo a wrong one by deleting its pair before export. Known limits: two admins refunding the same month at the same moment can both pass; a DWP refund covering several months counts against its first month only.

areas.desc: Rate promotion and F-Account increment update every record, with a gap report.
areas.name: Fiscal year cutover

areas.desc: Only authorized users see and change chargeback data; other Helix tenants are never affected.
areas.name: Security, audit and tenant isolation

areas.desc: Counters, views and buttons on the console show correct data and open the right records.
areas.name: Billing Operations Admin Console

areas.desc: Feed rows move into Chargeback staging once, are validated, and post only when clean; failures end in Error.
areas.name: Import staging

defects.desc: INC000000167334 (Smart IT, nfoy_rf, UAT Customer01, SKU UAT-901 Hourly $80, Time Worked = 50): Smart IT showed a Charge Amount preview of 300 before save and the record saved with Charge Amount 300.00 and Charge Amount_Details 'x 80 Hourly Rate = 300 Total'. Expected 60.00 (50 min - 15 free = 35, rounded up to 45 = 0.75 h x $80). The Incident hourly workflow in the build (NN:HPD:CGB_Incident_CalculateHourlyCharge active link and filter) computes TRUNC((Time Worked x 60 - 15 + 14) / 15) x 0.25 x Rate, i.e. it treats Time Worked (537888123) as HOURS: 50 would give 3,980.00 and 0.83 would give 60.00. 300.00 matches neither, so the value Smart IT shows and saves comes from somewhere else (Smart IT does not run classic active links, and the filter only recalculates on Modify when Time Worked changes). The Details text is also missing its first part (the hours). Smart IT also has a separate 'Minutes Worked' field (536870942) that no Incident chargeback workflow reads.

defects.desc: PAO Expiration Report, View by 'Expiring in 15 days': the table shows 0 rows, although SUB000000000205 is on 1000991-F271999991-999991 (PTAEO Expiration Date 10/25/2026). The View by active links write $DATE$ (and $DATE$ + 15) as text into z1D_CGB_Query, and the table uses EXTERNAL($z1D_CGB_Query$). In the mid-tier, '<= $DATE$ + 15' fails (ARERR 1581 'Unexpected character ... in the query line') and '>= $DATE$' matches every row, including 6/30/2023 dates. The same query with quoted literal dates ('>= "10/16/2026" AND <= "10/31/2026"') returns exactly the SUB205 row. 'Expired' happened to list the right rows (including SUB000000000204 on ACCT-EXP), but it uses the same $DATE$ text.
defects.title: PAO Expiration Report 'Expiring in 15 days' returns nothing ($DATE$ + 15 in an EXTERNAL query)
defects.work: v1 (Rockefeller_CGB_PAOReport_DateFilter_Fix_101626.def) fixed 'Expired' but not 'Expiring in 15 days': the client-side '$DATE$ + 15' was concatenated as text, giving the bound "10/17/202615", so every future date matched. v2: Rockefeller_CGB_PAOReport_DateFilter_Fix_v2_101726.def replaces CGB:PAO:SetQuery_Expiring15 so the upper bound is DATE($TIMESTAMP$ + 1296000) (now + 15 days in seconds, converted to a date). Expired active link unchanged. Chargeback workflow only. Import, flush cache, retest UT-B-11 Expiring in 15 days.

defects.desc: DWP 'I Have an Issue_RF' (category Device Issue), submitted on behalf of UAT Customer02 (Request as someone else, by UAT Technician). The read-only question 'Initial preferred or default PAO' is pre-filled with 1000999-F271999999-999999 (ACCT-A, the UAT-DEPT-01 department default). Customer02's preferred row (NN:CGB:CustomerPreferredPTAEO: 1000998-F271999998-999998, Default Account = Yes) is ignored. INC000000167367 (DWP request 35438) was created with PTAEO Account = ACCT-A. The server-side filters NN:HPD:CGB_PTAEO_030_PreferredLookup / 040_ApplyPreferred only run when PTAEO Account is empty, so the value sent by DWP is kept and ACCT-PREF is never applied. Customer01 (no active preferred row) got ACCT-A, which is correct (INC000000167368, request 35439). Earlier Smart IT tickets for Customer02 (INC000000167358) did get ACCT-PREF, so the Chargeback filters work when the PTAEO arrives empty.

defects.desc: Found during UT-F-05 setup: setting SUB000000000204 to Pending Termination (with a reason, same push as the Terminate reason window) gave Termination Effective Date = 7/29/4708 BC. NN:CGB:Admin:Subscription_TerminateSub builds 'MM/15/YYYY 23:59:59', but field 536870919 is a DATE field, which cannot take a time, so the conversion fails. The escalation NN:CGB:SUB:TerminateSubscription (13th-15th, 5 AM / 5 PM) terminates Pending Termination rows whose date is on or before today, so these rows would be terminated at its next run instead of at period end.
defects.title: Termination Effective Date is set to 7/29/4708 BC
defects.work: v1 (text MM/15/YYYY) still gave 7/29/4708 BC. v2 (Rockefeller_CGB_TerminationDate_Fix_v2_101726.def, date arithmetic $DATE$ - DAY + 15) imported 14:37. Retest: cleared and re-saved SUB000000000204 (Pending Termination) -> Termination Effective Date 10/15/2026. Full console Terminate flow still needs DEF-034 (UT-E-07).

defects.desc: STEP7 on run 000000000000001 (14:39, N. Foy) failed with 'Required field cannot be blank. : NN:CGB:Chargeback Ledger : PTAEO Debit Account (ARERR 326)'. Step 7 pushes POST to every Active / Pending Termination subscription in one transaction; 7 older subscriptions have no PTAEO (Step 5 flagged them Unresolved), so their ledger submit fails and the whole step rolls back - no subscription is billed. In production one bad subscription would stop the monthly billing run.
defects.title: Step 7 fails and posts nothing when any subscription has an empty PTAEO
defects.work: v1 rejected on import (qualification had one AND too many, ARERR 402); v2 imported 14:45. Step 7 no longer fails on empty-PTAEO subscriptions; Unresolved SUB000000000209 and the 16 older flagged ones were skipped.

defects.desc: After DEF-041, STEP7 still failed with ARERR 326 (PTAEO Debit Account blank). The credit row of each ledger pair takes its account from the subscription's PTAEO Credit Account / IT PTAEO (537888203). 42 Active subscriptions were created before NN:CGB:SUB:Submit_009_ITCreditAccount and have it empty, so their credit row is refused and the whole Step 7 rolls back.
defects.title: Step 7 fails on subscriptions with no IT credit account
defects.work: Imported 14:48; Step 7 then completed (29 pairs). Empty IT credit accounts are filled with 1000028-F271110510-110510 at posting.

defects.desc: Step 7 on run 000000000000001 completed (14:48) and posted 29 pairs (LDG000000000179-236), all for older subscriptions SUB000000000089-128. None of the 14 billable subscriptions created this month (SUB000000000201-216, incl. UT-E-01 SUB000000000210 and Pending Termination SUB000000000204) was posted; their Last Billed Period is empty. NN:CGB:RUN:STEP7_010_Execute selects subscriptions with 'Last Billed Period' != 'Current Period' in the database, and an empty value never matches a not-equal in SQL, so a new subscription is never billed.
defects.title: Step 7 never bills a subscription that has not been billed before
defects.work: Imported 10/17 14:54. Missed subscriptions posted with RERUN_STEP7 (14 pairs LDG000000000237-264). RETEST 10/31 (N. Foy: force the next period in DEV): billing run 000000000000101, period 2026-11 (server date already 11/1 GMT), Steps 5/6/7 run by hand as uat_billadmin. First Step 7 rolled back on DEF-086; after N. Foy widened the Ledger Originating Ticket, Step 7 completed 11/1 1:57:41 AM GMT. PASSED: SUB000000000217 (VM backup, created 10/20, never billed) now Last Billed Period 2026-11 and has its Debit/Credit pair (SKU 13292, 1000999-F271999999-999999 / 1000028-F271110510-110510, Pending). Pending ledger rows on the console went from 85 to 187 (about 51 new pairs). Note: these 2026-11 rows are test rows in DEV and will already be there for the real November cycle (the subscriptions' Last Billed Period is now 2026-11, so the scheduled run on the 15th will not post them again).

defects.desc: On NN:CGB:SystemwideSettings, RERUN_STEP7 wrote 'Step 7 ledger posting was blocked for 2026-10: Step 6 has no Complete record. No subscription charges were posted.' (AUD000000001922, 1924) although Step 6 was Complete and the first re-run posted 14 pairs. NN:CGB:RUN:705_Step7_CheckStep6 looks for a Step 6 Complete row in NN:CGB:AuditLog that no workflow writes (Step 6 status is on NN:CGB:BillingRun), and it runs at order 705, after 700 has already pushed POST. Posting is still protected by the subscription gate (GATE_010/020), so this is a misleading audit / weak gate, not a wrong posting.
defects.title: Step 7 re-run logs a false 'blocked' and its Step 6 check cannot stop posting
defects.work: Imported 18:02. Retest 18:06: RERUN_STEP7 with 2026-10 Step 6 Complete wrote AUD000000001949 'Complete - Step 7 subscription ledger posting complete for 2026-10; subscription ledger rows this period: 86' and no Blocked row; no new ledger rows. (The 17:59 Blocked row AUD000000001947 was the UT-F-09 run before the fix.) Note: re-entering the same z1D Action value without reloading does not save - reload or clear first.
